preceding and subsequent two fully completed minute closes

minute turnover and base volume at crossing as context, not order-book depth
simple illustrative mark-based outcomes under fill at stop, crossing-minute close, crossing-minute low, next-minute open, all after modeled 5bp slip and 10bp fee
